title: Enhancing landslide detection in Western Ghats of Kerala, India with deep learning and Explainable AI.
summary: An attention-based multiscale U-Net mapped landslide areas in Kerala from high-resolution satellite images before and after events. It performed best among the compared segmentation models; the work presents an initial inventory rather than a validated warning system.
ai_technology: An attention multiscale U-Net segments landslide areas from pre- and post-event high-resolution satellite imagery.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The model was evaluated on Kerala Western Ghats imagery for landslide inventory mapping; this does not demonstrate prospective warning or hazard reduction.
evidence.unknown: The mapping result is based on historical Kerala imagery and the reported landslide inventory; it does not test prospective warnings or reductions in landslide harm.
evidence.ai_role: An attention multiscale U-Net segments landslide areas from pre- and post-event high-resolution satellite imagery.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
